name: GQ-009 · The God Questions Observatory
summary: A standing meta-question about how the Great Library should make SISO's highest-value questions visible, composable, continuously revisable, and connected to evidence and approved action.

relationships.context: The Great Library is the public-safe registry and reading surface whose God Questions infrastructure this Work studies and dogfoods.

evidence.summary: The accepted identity model makes questions Works and accepted answers immutable Releases in the Great Library.

relationships.context: Foundry discovers source buckets, repositories, books, people, and watch signals relevant to each question without writing accepted truth.

evidence.summary: The question-driven architecture assigns evidence-universe discovery and monitoring to Foundry.

relationships.context: SISO Knowledge preserves the large rights-aware corpus and retrieval plane that question dossiers reference but do not duplicate.

evidence.summary: The published boundary assigns durable corpus custody, provenance, retrieval, indexes, and graphs to SISO Knowledge.

relationships.context: Evidence Engines turn explicit sources into traceable claims, contradictions, and graded evidence packages that may change a question answer.

evidence.summary: The question-driven architecture keeps evidence transformation independent from question identity and execution authority.

The existing six Frontier Question Works, V28 selection, question-driven research documentation, generated Research surface, and live operating-architecture debate were reviewed before adding this dogfood question.
The requested priority is the reusable God Questions Library infrastructure, using existing research as dogfood instead of producing redundant speculative answers.

A question-addressable corpus export now exists. 79,071 works are byte-addressable from any machine with no local data: one HTTP Range request against a release asset returned 26,460 bytes and yielded a complete 101,354-character book in 0.79s. This is the first source that can replace a manual evidence link with a resolvable locator.

Cross-domain people graph published: 280,708 people, 564,486 content edges spanning books/GitHub/YouTube, 2,050,629 topic edges across five deliberately-separate vocabularies. Verified by downloading from clean and querying.
41,501,325 passages indexed across 77,540 books as byte ranges into immutable source. Establishes the evidence granularity a question actually needs -- a paragraph, not a book.
